subjects.UNIT:CANDY:KNIGHT/BUNNY: Subject: a giant living moulded chocolate rabbit, like a hollow Easter chocolate figure, standing upright on big hind feet and leaning forward to charge: the whole body is one smooth piece of glossy milk chocolate, colour #7a4526, shaded dark chocolate #4a2412, with long hard white shine streaks; two tall upright ears, a round head with two cream-white dot eyes and a small cream nose, a fat round body, short arms held up like a boxer and very big flat hind feet; a wide caramel gold ribbon, colour #e0a040, tied in a bow round its neck with one small round gold bell; nothing else worn or carried; wide and heavy, bigger than a soldier; simple smooth shapes and very few details; clearly a chocolate sweet, not a real animal and not a plush toy; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:KNIGHT/ROCKING_HORSE: Subject: a chunky cute gingerbread rocking horse with a small rider: one big rocking horse cut from thick warm brown gingerbread biscuit, colour #b8703a, piped with white icing lines and a white icing mane and tail, standing on two curved dark chocolate rockers, colour #4a2412, with a caramel gold saddle; riding it, one small living toffee sweet, a golden toffee cube with two black dot eyes, a determined smile and two cream wrapper ends, holding one long candy-cane lance with cream white and caramel gold stripes and a hooked top, pointed forward; two short white speed lines behind the horse; the horse is much bigger than its rider; simple shapes and very few details; the rockers are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:KNIGHT/DIPPED_BEAR: Subject: the amber gummy sweet in the shape of a bear, dipped in dark chocolate and wearing chocolate armour: an edit of the live Gummy Bear (the recipe's instruction says what changes).
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT/GINGERBREAD: Subject: a huge towering living gingerbread man, far taller than a soldier: a thick biscuit figure of warm gingerbread brown, colour #b8703a, with the classic rounded gingerbread-man outline, a big round head, very broad shoulders, thick arms and thick short legs, all edged with a wavy line of white icing; a face of white icing, two round eyes and a wide determined mouth; three big round gumdrop buttons down its chest in mint green, caramel gold and cherry pink; two huge dark chocolate gauntlet fists, colour #4a2412, and dark chocolate boots; one cream icing bow tie; wide and towering; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT/CAKE: Subject: a huge walking three-tier chocolate cake colossus, far taller than a soldier: three round stacked tiers, the widest at the bottom, of dark chocolate sponge, colour #4a2412, each with thick cream white frosting, colour #fff1d0, on its top edge and one caramel gold band; the face is on the middle tier, two big round cream eyes with dark pupils and a wide friendly smile; on the top tier a ring of small lit candles in cream and gold like a crown with one cherry in the middle; two thick short chocolate arms with big round cream fists at its sides, and two short thick legs with dark chocolate feet under the bottom tier; wide, heavy and towering; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT/EGG: Subject: a huge living chocolate Easter egg titan, far taller than a soldier: the whole body is one giant upright egg of glossy milk chocolate, colour #7a4526, wrapped in shiny caramel gold foil, colour #e0a040, that is torn open across the front so the chocolate egg and its face show: two round cream eyes under a heavy brow and a straight determined mouth; a wide cream ribbon with a big bow tied round its middle; two thick short arms of dark chocolate with big round fists and two short thick legs with dark chocolate feet; a few cracks in the shell near its top; wide, round and towering; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
